questions.question: Vigilance Awareness Week 2026 is observed around the birth anniversary of which visionary leader?
questions.option_a: Mahatma Gandhi
questions.option_b: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel
questions.option_c: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar
questions.option_d: Deshbandhu Chittaranjan Das

questions.question: The theme of Vigilance Awareness Week 2026 is:
questions.option_a: Vigilance: Our Shared Responsibility
questions.option_b: Culture of Integrity for Nation’s Prosperity
questions.option_c: Probity for Prosperity
questions.option_d: Integrity for Development

questions.question: The Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) is the apex vigilance body of the Central Government. It was set up in which year on the recommendation of the Santhanam Committee?
Which rules primarily govern the conduct, integrity and behaviour expected of railway servants?:
questions.option_a: Railway Services (Conduct) Rules, 1966
questions.option_b: Railway General Rules, 1976
questions.option_c: Indian Railways Act, 1989
questions.option_d: Railway Servants (Pass) Rules

questions.question: At a Production Unit of Indian Railways such as CLW, the vigilance organisation is headed by:
questions.option_a: Principal Chief Engineer (PCE)
questions.option_b: Chief Security Commissioner (RPF)
questions.option_c: Principal Financial Adviser (PFA)
questions.option_d: SDGM & Chief Vigilance Officer (CVO)

questions.question: Preventive vigilance is best described as:
questions.option_a: Punishment after a charge sheet is proved
questions.option_b: Watchfulness, systemic improvements and transparency to stop irregularities before they occur
questions.option_c: A purely police and detective function
questions.option_d: An annual celebration without operational checks

questions.question: PIDPI (Public Interest Disclosure and Protection of Informers) complaints are meant for:
questions.option_a: where the complainant’s identity is protected by CVC
questions.option_b: Posting grievances on public social media handles
questions.option_c: Filing routine leave or transfer appeals
questions.option_d: Publishing vendor brochures

questions.question: Under Rule 13 of the Railway Services (Conduct) Rules 1966, a railway servant must avoid accepting gifts from:
questions.option_a: Any commercial firm and contractor having official dealings with the railway
questions.option_b: Blood relatives on official festivals
questions.option_c: Departmental staff sports club awards
questions.option_d: The President of India

questions.question: A Conflict of Interest arises in official duties when:
questions.option_a: A private or familial interest may compromise
questions.option_b: A public servant follows published tender criteria
questions.option_c: A file is marked through proper departmental hierarchy
questions.option_d: An officer attends an official inspection during duty hours

questions.question: On Government e-Marketplace (GeM), which procurement practice is strictly prohibited under Rule 157 of GFR?
questions.option_a: Comparing technical specifications objectively
questions.option_b: Selecting products under Direct Purchase within allowed thresholds
questions.option_c: Splitting purchase indents or work estimates to evade higher financial sanction
questions.option_d: Maintaining complete procurement audit trails

questions.question: What is the Canon of Financial Propriety expected from every public officer handling expenditure?
questions.option_a: Spend budget quickly before financial year ends without vouchers
questions.option_b: Exercise the same degree of vigilance and prudence as a person of ordinary prudence would exercise for their own money
questions.option_c: Approve expenditures that directly benefit their own family
questions.option_d: Avoid obtaining financial concurrence for high-value tenders

questions.question: Under the Information Technology Act 2000, sharing an officer’s Digital Signature Certificate (DSC) USB token and PIN with colleagues is:
questions.option_a: Permissible if verbally instructed by a supervisor
questions.option_b: Acceptable during weekend shifts
questions.option_c: Encouraged to speed up file movement during annual leaves
questions.option_d: A serious statutory and cyber security violation as DSC is legally personal to the subscriber

questions.question: Under Section 8 of the Prevention of Corruption (Amendment) Act 2018, which party is explicitly liable for direct criminal prosecution?
questions.option_a: The person who gives or promises to give an undue advantage (bribe-giver)
questions.option_b: Only the receiver of bribe
questions.option_c: Only foreign companies
questions.option_d: No one is prosecuted under Section 8

questions.question: Inflated measurements in a railway works contract are an irregularity that:
questions.option_a: Is normal practice on construction sites
questions.option_b: Can cause wrongful pecuniary loss to the railways and attracts vigilance / DAR proceedings
questions.option_c: Should be resolved without inspecting the site
questions.option_d: Falls exclusively under the Rajbhasha branch

questions.question: What is the Central Vigilance Commission’s policy regarding post-tender negotiations?
questions.option_a: Post-tender negotiations are strictly banned, except in rare exceptional cases solely with the lowest valid bidder (L1)
questions.option_b: Negotiations can be held with all bidders simultaneously
questions.option_c: Negotiations can be conducted with any favorite bidder
questions.option_d: Bidders can increase their rates after price bids open

questions.question: Periodic "Rotational Transfers" of railway staff in sensitive posts is implemented primarily to:
questions.option_a: Reduce office telephone expenses
questions.option_b: Break entrenched corrupt nexus with suppliers/contractors and uphold impartiality
questions.option_c: Cancel all past performance records
questions.option_d: Prevent staff from learning other skills

questions.question: The Integrity Pledge taken during Vigilance Awareness Week is meant to:
questions.option_a: Grant immunity from past enquiries
questions.option_b: Replace official service conduct rules
questions.option_c: Reaffirm unconditional commitment to honesty
questions.option_d: Waive property declaration requirements

questions.question: If a railway employee discovers a suspected fraudulent voucher or cyber irregularity, what should they do?
questions.option_a: Promptly bring it to notice of Higher authority
questions.option_b: Destroy or shred the documents quietly
questions.option_c: Share unverified allegations on private social media groups
questions.option_d: Ignore it if no direct personal loss is felt

questions.question: Under Rule 15 of Railway Services (Conduct) Rules 1966, engaging in private trade or commercial employment requires:
questions.option_a: No permission if done on Sundays
questions.option_b: A note written in personal diary
questions.option_c: Only a verbal intimation to the peon
questions.option_d: Previous sanction of the Competent Authority

questions.question: The core motto "Probity for Prosperity (सत्यनिष्ठा से समृद्धि)" conveys that:
questions.option_a: Rules may be ignored if production volume is high
questions.option_b: Integrity is required only when vigilance officers are inspecting
questions.option_c: Integrity is a shared national duty fundamental to sustainable economic and institutional growth
questions.option_d: Vigilance is restricted exclusively to the vigilance branch

questions.question: What does PIDPI stand for in the context of anti-corruption mechanisms in India?:
questions.option_a: Public Interest Disclosure and Protection of Informers
questions.option_b: Public Inquiry Department and Prevention Investigation
questions.option_c: Public Integrity and Direct Prosecution Institution
questions.option_d: Preventive Investigation and Disciplinary Procedure Index

questions.question: Which of the following is a fundamental principle of fair public procurement?:
questions.option_a: Preference for familiar contractors regardless of eligibility
questions.option_b: Transparency, fairness, competition and value for money
questions.option_c: Selecting the highest bidder in every case
questions.option_d: Changing eligibility criteria after opening bids to favour a particular bidder

questions.question: A procurement officer divides one large requirement into several smaller purchases solely to avoid the prescribed approval or tendering threshold. This practice is best described as:
questions.option_a: Delegation of powers
questions.option_b: Decentralisation
questions.option_c: Improper splitting of procurement
questions.option_d: Normal inventory management

questions.question: What is the limit up to which a railway employee can acquire or dispose of immovable property without prior intimation or sanction from the prescribed authority under Conduct Rules?
questions.option_a: Transactions up to Rs. 10,000
questions.option_b: Transactions up to Rs. 50,000
questions.option_c: Transactions up to 2 months' basic pay
questions.option_d: Intimation is mandatory for all transactions regardless of value

questions.question: Which Act provides the principal statutory framework for railway operations, passenger and goods carriage, and various railway-related offences in India?
questions.option_a: Indian Railways Act, 1890
questions.option_b: Railways Act, 1989
questions.option_c: Railway Board Act, 1905
questions.option_d: Public Premises Act, 1971

questions.question: The Commissioner of Railway Safety functions under the administrative control of which ministry?
questions.option_a: Ministry of Railways
questions.option_b: Ministry of Home Affairs
questions.option_c: Ministry of Civil Aviation
questions.option_d: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
